free_tier.stated: Bulk Parquet files across all weather stations (hourly and daily as one file per year, monthly as a single file) and full per-station CSV time series, with no key and no sign-up; no quota is published.
free_tier.notes: The 2024 hourly file for all stations declares 992,333,139 bytes; the 2024 hourly CSV for station 10637 downloaded at 133,686 bytes. Recent hourly data lands within 24 hours. The files are not versioned: columns can be added or reordered without notice.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: read-only files; the 2024 hourly all-station Parquet file declares 992,333,139 bytes

egress.terms: no fee and no key on data.meteostat.net; a 2024 hourly station file downloaded and a 992,333,139-byte Parquet file answered HTTP 200 with no account

interface_detail: plain HTTPS downloads from data.meteostat.net: hourly/{year}.parquet and daily/{year}.parquet (one file per year) and monthly.parquet (one file) for all stations; hourly/{year}/{station}.csv.gz and daily/{year}/{station}.csv.gz and monthly/{station}.csv.gz per station; station metadata in JSON and SQL
tooling: any HTTP client; the Meteostat Python library wraps the files
chaining: A keyless bulk source of station history: one Parquet file per year for hourly and daily, and one Parquet file for monthly, covers every station, so a full year of hourly observations is one download.
binding_note: No quota is published for the files and no key is asked; the size of one year of hourly data (992,333,139 bytes) is the practical unit of a pull.

identity_cost.detail: No sign-up and no API key for the bulk and time-series files; a station file and a bulk file answered HTTP 200 with no credentials.

reliability_note: Meteostat may discontinue or block access at any time without prior notice; a year with no data answers HTTP 404.
confidence_note: The 2024 hourly CSV for station 10637 downloaded in full (133,686 bytes) with no credentials, and the 2024 hourly all-station Parquet file answered HTTP 200 declaring 992,333,139 bytes (the first 1,048,576 bytes were read).
